name: 克里斯蒂娜·马尼
name_full: 克里斯蒂娜·马尼 Christina Mani
introduction: Christina is a classical music composer who was born in Athens, Greece. She originally pursued a career in journalism. While attending the University of Kingston, she took acting and music classes at the prestigious Academy of Music and Dramatic Arts in London, LAMDA.She has been studying classical music since the age of 5 and her passion for performing piano in front of audiences led her to study theatre in London and later in Los Angeles. Her love for theatre and cinema landed her many roles in various independent movies and theatre plays. Her main focus is writing classical pieces on the piano, she considers herself more of a musician as she quotes.
